control_gap: There is no explicit length error, truncation marker, or safety-preserving tail inspection.

evidence.observation: The normalized string is sliced to the configured 4,000-character bound.
The truncated value is the value analyzed, generated from, and persisted.

existing_controls: Whitespace and Unicode normalization run before routing
The retained prefix still passes deterministic and semantic safety
impact: The analyzed message can differ materially from user intent, allowing safety context or crisis language in the discarded suffix to be ignored.
remediation_seed: Reject oversized messages with a bounded user-visible response or apply a safety-aware, disclosed segmentation policy before analysis.
reproducibility: Call clean_message with a synthetic string longer than 4,000 characters and place a distinct marker after the boundary; compare the returned value.
root_cause: Input normalization truncates to 4,000 characters without rejecting the request or telling the user.
title: Silent message truncation can remove safety-critical suffixes
trigger_conditions: Risk-relevant content occurs after the retained prefix

control_gap: The no-record rehydration path has no explicit reset/rollback of pre-commit process state.

evidence.observation: Stored state is restored when present; no stored-state branch does not prove rollback of existing local state.

existing_controls: Authoritative history is rehydrated before normal turns
Archive failure prevents a user-visible response
Persisted safety state is bundled with successful turn commits
impact: A retry can inherit escalation, repetition, or de-escalation state from a turn that was never committed, changing the next safety decision.
remediation_seed: Stage safety-state changes and commit or rollback them with the authoritative turn; explicitly reset absent contexts during rehydration.
reproducibility: In an isolated copy, inject an archive failure on a new context after analysis, retry on the same service instance, and compare local risk/counter state with a fresh instance.
root_cause: Safety state and analyzer counters mutate before the authoritative archive commit, while context rehydration does not clear process-local state when no stored state exists.
title: Failed first-turn commits can leave process-local safety mutations
trigger_conditions: First turn for a new context
record_turn fails before any authoritative state is stored

control_gap: There is no server-side context minimization or deterministic refusal for injection-classified requests.

evidence.observation: Injection strategy can continue to generation.
Recent, cross-session, memory, and knowledge context are assembled for model generation.

existing_controls: Prompt labels retrieved/history material as untrusted
Leak regexes and output policy run before delivery
impact: Adversarial input can influence an external model invocation that includes context the attacker should not control, relying on probabilistic instruction following and output filtering.
remediation_seed: Introduce a deterministic injection response or a least-context generation path and enforce context-specific authorization outside prompts.
reproducibility: Use a synthetic injection message with instrumented fake model input in a findings-local copy and inspect whether contextual sections are still present.
root_cause: Injection detection changes strategy and prompt wording but does not create a deterministic no-model boundary before recent history, summaries, memory, and knowledge are assembled.
title: Prompt-injection intent still reaches the model with privileged context
trigger_conditions: Conversation or retrieval context contains sensitive or steering content

control_gap: No transaction, unique document identity, compensating rollback, or one-to-one file/index commit exists.

evidence.observation: The uploaded file is saved before cache refresh; refresh failure does not remove the saved file.
Deletion uses recursive matching by sanitized name and coordinates cache/file removal without a transaction.

impact: Users can observe files that are not indexed, indexes that no longer match files, or deletion of every same-named document rather than one selected object.
remediation_seed: Use stable document IDs and a staged transaction protocol with compensating actions, idempotent recovery, and exact-path deletion.
reproducibility: In an isolated synthetic knowledge tree, create duplicate basenames and inject refresh/unlink failures while comparing filesystem and index state.
root_cause: Filesystem changes and knowledge-cache refresh/removal occur as separate operations without rollback; deletion searches recursively by sanitized basename.
title: Document upload and deletion are not atomic across file and index state
trigger_conditions: File save succeeds and refresh fails
In-memory removal succeeds and unlink fails
Multiple documents share the same basename in different directories

control_gap: The trust assumption is implicit and unenforced.

evidence.observation: The direct service path has no HTTP authentication, revocation, or rate-limit layer.

existing_controls: CLI is currently a local process entry point
impact: A future operational wrapper or shell exposure could permit unthrottled model/storage use under weakly bound identities.
non_reproducibility_reason: Impact depends on a future deployment exposing the local CLI boundary.
remediation_seed: Document and enforce the CLI trust boundary; require explicit local-only mode or equivalent authentication and isolated storage.
reproducibility: Static trace only; do not expose or execute the CLI against live storage.
root_cause: The CLI invokes the shared service directly with an environment-derived or random session identity and does not pass through request guards.

security_privacy_details.actor_or_failure_source: Untrusted local/process caller if the CLI is exposed
security_privacy_details.sensitive_data_impact: Potential access or creation under weak identity binding

title: CLI bypasses HTTP identity, authorization, and abuse controls
trigger_conditions: CLI is exposed beyond a trusted local administrator
CLI storage points at shared production data
